title: Russian deception as source of some UAP

tellings.quote:
>> And the Russians in particular really do
a lot of this.

plain: Some UAP, the government's term for UFOs, may be Russian deception operations meant to fool the US military, says Eric Haseltine, a former senior official at the NSA, adding that "the Russians in particular really do a lot of this." He tells Michels this in a conversation that also brings up General George Patton, and if right, some sightings would be staged tricks rather than anything unknown.
